market_policy.downstream_join: only after immutable forecast freeze; diagnostic only

unavailable_rule: no supported total => no team scores; no selected later record => no certified incumbent score benchmark
inner_splits: expanding chronological season origins restricted to outer training; first 2019->2020
current_season_update: weekly completed games with week<target_week and available_at<cutoff; update hyperparameters fixed earlier
preprocessing: all scaling, imputation, selection and uncertainty inside training folds
uncertainty_fit: inner out-of-fold residuals or posterior predictive samples; not in-sample residual SD
inner_selection: minimum primary loss; within one standard error prefer fewer blocks then stronger shrinkage
distribution_support: prerequisite T2; any performance alternative needs separate preregistered extension
missingness: report all exclusions and overlap plus all-eligible policy loss with declared research-reference fallback

bootstrap.development_family: simultaneous bootstrap over all six declared contenders; descriptive only

practical_effect.rationale: predeclared engineering utility floor: one point less combined absolute score error/game; not estimated from audit

activation.permission: separate future activation decision; this audit creates no shadow log

power_design.dispersion: development paired season-week blocks; season dependence sensitivity
power_design.if_failed: insufficient design; no activation or post-result window extension

prospective_window: two complete regular seasons starting after activation; partial season descriptive only

prospective_decision.if_incumbent_scores_unavailable: new capability versus named research reference, never incumbent-score improvement

artifact_immutability: append corrections with supersedes; never rewrite forecasts
